messages:
Maya Chen: FYI, vendor AuroraStack submitted invoice INV-7842 for $18,450 but it doesn't list the PO we have on file. Vendor claims PO 98765 but AP lookup shows PO 98765 was split across two cost centers in Sept. Invoice due 2024-11-02. attaching invoice: https://redwood-s3.internal/invoices/INV-7842.pdf :warning:
Omar Patel: can you paste the invoice header or a screenshot? quick check — maybe they used an old PO variant
Maya Chen: excerpt from invoice:
```
Invoice: INV-7842
Vendor PO: 98765
Lines:
 - PROD: $12,000
 - SUPPORT: $6,450
Total: $18,450
Remit: AuroraStack LLC
```
Priya Desai: thanks — PO 98765 was amended (PO-98765-A) and split: GL 5200 (product) / GL 5201 (support). Approver routing for the amended PO was updated to Lisa K. The vendor should reference PO-98765-A. If they only used 98765, the AP system won't auto-route to Lisa.
Eric Nguyen: AP system flagged INV-7842 as "PO mismatch" and put it on hold (code HLD-PO-MISMATCH). Payment blocked until we get matching PO reference or manual approver. Due date 2024-11-02 — we should avoid aging past due.
Maya Chen: what's the fastest path? can we manually route to Lisa K and approve so it doesn't hit late fees?
Priya Desai: two options: 1) ask vendor to reissue invoice with PO-98765-A in header (preferred), or 2) AP can process a manual exception and route to Lisa for approval using the amendment doc I can attach. I'll upload the PO amendment now.
AccountsPayableBot: Invoice INV-7842 status updated -> ON_HOLD (HLD-PO-MISMATCH) at 1716601301
AuroraStack Billing: Hi Redwood team — sorry about that, we used the original PO number. I'm uploading a corrected invoice now (INV-7842-v2.pdf) that includes PO-98765-A and the amendment reference. Link: https://vendor-files.aurorastack.com/INV-7842-v2.pdf
Omar Patel: received the v2 link, thanks. Eric, can AP accept the corrected invoice and kick for routing?
Eric Nguyen: yes — if the doc contains PO-98765-A we can clear the hold. I'll attach it to the AP ticket and route to Lisa K. ETA routing + initial approval request ~ 2 business hours.
Maya Chen: perfect. Priya — can you confirm the amendment you mentioned is the same one vendor referenced?
Priya Desai: confirmed — amendment id PO-98765-A matches. I'll cc Lisa and the vendor so approvals are visible.
AccountsPayableBot: Invoice INV-7842 updated -> QUEUED_FOR_APPROVAL (approver: Lisa K) at 1716601523
Lisa K (via Priya Desai): I'll approve as soon as the AP ticket shows the attached amendment.
Eric Nguyen: noted, payment scheduled for next Tuesday (2024-11-05) once approval clears. I'll remove the hold after Lisa approves.
Maya Chen: thanks everyone — marking this thread resolved once payment is scheduled. :thumbsup:
